column1: # *** THE TAYLOR SISTERS IN 1911 - the census this archive had never read. ***
# Until 14 September 2026 it held only 1891 and 1901, both of the parental household at Northam. By 1911
# William Taylor was nine years dead and the household had scattered. Reading 1911 finds the sisters in
# their own homes, with husbands' occupations and *** a whole generation of Mary Septima's nieces and
# nephews that this archive had never recorded. ***
household
*** HENRY DALLING ***, head, 32, b.1879 Bideford, married, *** GARDENER (DOMESTIC) ***
column2: Northam, Devon - RG14 piece/folio 299, sub-district Northam, ED 6, schedule 150
column3: *** Isabella Temple Dalling, 37 *** (the sister); HORACE HENRY CHARLES DALLING, 10; RONALD WILLIAM JAMES DALLING, 8; SYLVIA MARY DALLING, 0 - all born Northam. And *** KATHLEEN GEORGINA TAYLOR, 41, SINGLE, entered as "Sister" ***
column4: *** THREE NIECES AND NEPHEWS AT ONE STROKE - and Henry Dalling's trade. *** He is FIVE YEARS YOUNGER than his wife. *** And the eldest boy is HORACE HENRY CHARLES - named for his uncle HORACE ARCHIBALD TAYLOR - while RONALD WILLIAM JAMES carries his grandfather's name. ***

column1: *** HENRY ALBERT BURTON ***
column2: *** BIDEFORD, Devon *** (1911); and *** BERMONDSEY, LONDON *** in 1901
column3: *** Irene Burton, 32, b.1879 Northam ***; children *** CHARLES WILLIAM BURTON *** and *** ALBERT EDWARD BURTON ***
column4: *** TWO MORE NEPHEWS - and a journey nobody here had seen. *** Irene married at Northam on 30 August 1900 and was living in BERMONDSEY, SOUTH LONDON by the census of 31 March 1901 - seven months later. By 1911 the Burtons are back in Bideford, four miles from where she was born. She died in Devon in 1969.

column1: # *** KATHLEEN GEORGINA TAYLOR IS ENTERED AS "SINGLE", AGED 41, IN HER MARRIED SISTER'S HOUSE. *** This
# archive recorded her with no husband on a tree's silence, which is not evidence of anything. It is now
# evidence: at forty-one she was unmarried and living with Isabella and Henry Dalling at Northam.
# *** Whether she married AFTER 1911 is untested *** - she lived until 1940 - but the eldest of the ten
# daughters keeping house with a younger married sister at forty-one is a life this archive can now
# describe rather than leave blank.
# A FIND A GRAVE entry for a "Kathleen Georgina Taylor" buried at BROMPTON CEMETERY, London, giving a
# death of 24 JULY 1942, was seen and *** NOT attached: *** this archive's Kathleen died 29 FEBRUARY 1940.
# Two years and a different city. Recorded so the next person does not attach it either.
# ---- STILL TO DO ON 1911 AND 1921 ----
# MARGARET HELEN WALKER BELL - not found in 1911. "Charles William Bell" is too common a name to search on;
#   it needs her own distinctive forenames.
# LUCY ELIZABETH SWEET, AGNES WALKER WOOD (m.1918), HORACE ARCHIBALD TAYLOR, WILLIAM JOHN TAYLOR - not yet
